WR+3.name: Longleap
WR+3.note: WH CANON move. Her namesake: a full-sprint leaping kick, rabbit-style — she covers half the arena and lands kicking. Her courier route, weaponized.

f,F+4.name: Courier's Dash
f,F+4.note: WH CANON move. A blurring dash-kick — the fastest approach in the roster. She delivers the hit before the opponent finishes reading the address.

b+1+2.name: Tip-Off
b+1+2.note: WH CANON move. A quick shoulder-barge — her left hand stays on the satchel strap, so the shoulder does the talking. Named for the night she tipped off Ryusan: one bump, one warning, gone.

SS+3+4.name: Satchel Swing
SS+3+4.note: WH CANON move. Sidestep into a spinning swing of the weighted courier satchel — the one thing she never lets go of, and the last thing you see. The undelivered letter stays inside. It always stays inside.

qcf+3.name: Escape Soul Flurry
qcf+3.note: WH CANON move. A five-kick flurry at courier speed — the Escape Soul doesn't retreat, she relocates, and every relocation hurts.

d+1+2.name: The Undelivered Letter
d+1+2.note: WH CANON super. She finally opens the satchel — and the letter comes out swinging. Whatever is written in it hits like a truck. Costs a full Nine-Soul Meter. She puts it back immediately after. Some things stay withheld.

canon_note: TOBI — the Escape Soul (WH name for the SmutBase Mirko intake, roster/miruko). Rabbit courier, fastest in the roster; tipped off Ryusan. She carries one letter she never delivered — withheld — and her left hand never leaves the satchel strap, so her left-side strikes land as shoulder-barges and elbow checks rather than punches. Moveset = Hwoarang's Tekken 3 kit (relentless kick strings, LFF/RFF foot-switching, Flamingo stances) translated onto Tobi's courier body, plus proprietary escape-artist moves layered on top. Technical: moveset source Hwoarang lives in technical files only, never in canon.

stances.name: Left Foot Forward
stances.description: Tobi's default courier stance. The Hwoarang base alternates feet with nearly every string — she is never standing the same way twice, which is the point.

stances.name: Right Foot Forward
stances.description: The mirror stance. Strings flow LFF->RFF->LFF; Tobi's speed makes the switch nearly invisible.

stances.name: Left Flamingo Stance
stances.description: One-legged stance, left foot raised. Documented Hwoarang T3 stance; on Tobi it reads as a courier's mid-stride pause — she looks like she's about to run and kicks instead.

stances.name: Right Flamingo Stance
stances.description: Mirror flamingo. The decoded T3 bank carries stance_slot codes for these transitions (see teardown/tekken3/movesets/moveset_hwoarang.json); names follow Hwoarang's documented T3 stance system.

combos.note: Basic jab string that switches feet — the engine of the whole kit.
Round-ender and round-starter. If she's running, you're already hit.
Courier's Dash into Satchel Swing — her canon approach.
Shoulder-barge counter-hit into the Escape Soul Flurry.
The Undelivered Letter. Save it for when it matters — she only opens the satchel once.

Existing entries gained only an anim_ref field where one was missing. wh: refs are placeholders for animations not yet authored (see canon file header); made: refs are wiring labels pending the sibling animation lane clips. t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.
